name: Archiver
tip: Storage you volunteered for other people. A quota is a ceiling, not a target — and nothing of yours is ever evicted to make room.

children.name: status
children.label: This device
children.tip: What is currently being held for other people.

children.name: quota
children.label: Hold for other people
children.tip: Zero by default: a device that never volunteered holds nothing for anybody.

children.name: followed
children.label: Keep media from people I follow
children.tip: Redundancy for the accounts you already care about.

children.name: mirror
children.label: Take the load off nearby phones
children.tip: Mirror what battery-powered devices share, then answer for it so the network stops waking them.

children.name: from_lan
children.label: Accept from the local network
children.tip: A peer on your LAN has no route to anywhere else. Its data dies if you refuse it.

children.name: from_bluetooth
children.label: Accept over Bluetooth
children.tip: Short range: this peer is physically here, and has nowhere else to go.

children.name: from_radio
children.label: Accept over LoRa / packet radio
children.tip: Slow and precious. The sender paid for every byte.

name: Space
tip: Where the space went, and how to get it back. Every cleanup says what it will free before it frees it.

children.name: space
children.tip: Statistics, biggest depositors, and previewed cleanups. Tap a cleanup to run exactly what it showed you.
